title: 第20章 感知Lv1
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
陈峰立刻退进武馆内部。

    外面的声响越来越剧烈，轰隆声、嘶鸣声、人的喊叫声混杂在一起。

    穿透浓雾传过来，听得人头皮直炸。

    陈峰没有往外探头，而是快步返回二楼，沿着走廊尽头上了天台。

    天台位置高，视野更开阔。

    他伏低身子，趴在水泥护栏后面，朝声响传来的方向望去。

    浓雾翻涌，能见度极差。

    但那边的动静实在太大了，哪怕隔着将近一公里的距离，陈峰依然能看到雾中影影绰绰的巨大轮廓。

    一头螳螂。

    不，不能叫螳螂了。

    那东西站起来足有两层楼高，前肢是两柄巨大的锯齿刀臂，每一次挥动都带起尖锐的破空声。

    刀臂劈落的瞬间，一栋残破的民房被直接斩成两截，砖石飞溅，烟尘冲天。

    在它前方，有几个人影正在拼命奔逃。

    在废墟的断壁残垣之间快速辗转腾挪。

    几人身形速度极快，力道极大，陈峰目测至少也有淬体境后期的实力。

    但依旧在那头巨型螳螂的追猎下疯狂逃窜。

    “唰！”

    螳螂刀锋呼啸掠过，半空中一道人影当场拦腰斩成两截，鲜血喷涌！

    紧接着刀锋没有丝毫滞涩的摧毁一栋民房。

    而其余几道人影更是丝毫不敢回头，依旧继续逃窜。

    几道身影越跑越远，连带着那头巨型螳螂一起，逐渐脱离了陈峰的视线。

    陈峰趴在天台上，看得心惊肉跳。

    “操……”

    他低声骂了一句，缓缓坐起身来，有些心有余悸。

    那头螳螂的体型和威压，比猎影蛛高出了不知道多少个档次。

    哪怕只是隔着一公里远远望着，那种压迫感都让人窒息。

    “真特么恐怖……”

    陈峰摇了摇头，目光扫过天台外的四周。

    似乎是因为刚刚追杀的动静，原本沉寂的浓雾中，仿佛开始躁动起来，已经隐约能听到一些细碎的响动。

    “算了，不能再继续探索了。”

    陈峰从天台退回楼内，随便挑了一间学员宿舍，关上房门。

    随后打开面板，意识触碰黑门图标。

    黑暗降临。

    ……

    出租屋内。

    陈峰睁开眼睛。

    灯光明亮，窗外的车流声川流不息。

    陈峰站在客厅中，把防毒面罩摘下来，长长呼出一口气。

    脑海中还在回放刚才的画面。

    从刚刚的场景来看，这个世界的人类并没有彻底灭亡，还是有原住民在的。
content_en:
Chen Feng immediately retreated into the martial arts hall.

    The noise outside became more and more intense, with rumblings, roars, and shouts mixed together.

    It came through the thick fog, and people's scalps were heard to explode.

    Chen Feng did not poke his head outside, but quickly returned to the second floor and walked up to the rooftop along the end of the corridor.

    The rooftop is high and has a wider view.

    He lowered himself behind the concrete guardrail and looked in the direction of the sound.

    Dense fog rolled in and visibility was extremely poor.

    But the movement there was too great. Even from a distance of nearly one kilometer, Chen Feng could still see the huge silhouette in the fog.

    A praying mantis.

    No, we can’t call him mantis anymore.

    The thing stood two stories tall, and its forelimbs were two huge serrated blade arms. Every time it swung, it made a sharp sound.

    The moment the blade arm fell, a dilapidated house was cut into two pieces, with bricks and stones flying and smoke rising into the sky.

    In front of it, several figures were running desperately.

    Quickly moving around among the broken walls of the ruins.

    Several of them were extremely fast and powerful. Chen Feng visually estimated that they were at least at the late stage of the Body Tempering Realm.

    But he still ran away frantically while being hunted by the giant mantis.

    "Uh-huh!"

    The mantis blade whizzed past, and a figure cut into two pieces in mid-air, blood spurting out!

    Immediately afterwards, the blade destroyed a private house without any hesitation.

    The other figures did not dare to look back at all and continued to run away.

    Several figures ran further and further away, and together with the giant mantis, they gradually disappeared from Chen Feng's sight.

    Chen Feng lay on the rooftop, watching with horror.

    "Fuck..."

    He cursed in a low voice and slowly sat up, feeling a little frightened.

    The size and pressure of that mantis were several levels higher than those of the Shadow Hunter Spider.

    Even looking at it from a distance of one kilometer, the feeling of oppression is suffocating.

    "It's so scary..."

    Chen Feng shook his head and glanced around outside the rooftop.

    It seems that due to the movement of the chase just now, the originally silent fog seemed to start to become restless, and some faint sounds could be heard.

    "Forget it, we can't continue exploring."

    Chen Feng returned to the building from the rooftop, randomly picked a student dormitory, and closed the door.

    Then open the panel and touch the black door icon consciously.

    Darkness falls.

    …

    In a rental house.

    Chen Feng opened his eyes.

    The lights are bright and the sound of traffic outside the window is endless.

    Chen Feng stood in the living room, took off his gas mask, and let out a long breath.

    The scene just now is still replaying in my mind.

    Judging from the scene just now, humans in this world have not been completely destroyed, and there are still indigenous people.
